business_problem: SKYGEN needed a finance and planning platform that could replace Great Plains, give managers real-time visibility into profitability, tighten subledger-to-general-ledger connections, and support a fast-growing healthcare technology business.
solution_summary: SKYGEN replaced Microsoft Dynamics Great Plains with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Fusion Cloud EPM running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, using Oracle Cloud ERP Project Management to connect project work, time, expenses, and profitability analysis in one system. Transactional finance, planning, order management, subscription workflows, and project costing now operate from a common interface and shared dataset instead of disconnected ledgers and manual reporting steps. The integrated ledgers and built-in reconciliation tools in Oracle Cloud ERP make close and account analysis faster, while Cloud EPM extends planning across finance, supply chain, sales, and operations. Because management can see profitability by customer and project in one place, the finance team has shifted from assembling statements to advising leaders. The platform gives SKYGEN a source of truth for budgeting, supplier status, and business performance rather than reports that used to take weeks to assemble.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP
solution_components.role: Runs SKYGEN's core finance, order management, subscription, and reconciliation processes on one cloud platform.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud EPM
solution_components.role: Supports enterprise planning and forecasting across finance, supply chain, and sales.

solution_components.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
solution_components.role: Provides the scalable and reliable cloud foundation for the ERP and EPM environment.

solution_components.name: Oracle Cloud ERP Project Management
solution_components.role: Links project costing, time, and expense workflows to broader financial and profitability analysis.

data_flow: Financial, project, supplier, and operational data flows into Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and EPM on OCI, where integrated ledgers and planning models create profitability and KPI views that managers across finance and operations can access without waiting for manual report assembly.
business_outcome: SKYGEN shortened its financial close to 10 days, created a single source of truth for profitability and KPI analysis, and turned finance into a more strategic function by replacing slow, disconnected reporting with current cloud-based insight.
architecture_clues: Integrated ledgers and reconciliation tools are built into the ERP layer
Project management data is tied directly to financial and profitability reporting
EPM extends planning horizontally and vertically across the business
evidence_quotes: With Oracle Cloud ERP’s integrated ledgers and embedded finance analysis and reconciliation tools, SKYGEN executed its financial close in just 10 days.
management received current updates on profitability—including by project and customer—across the business.
